Plainsflame Ribs
Lay tartakka ribs over a simmering fire and brush them with sweet 
and spicy ilyrana sauce that caramelizes into a glossy glaze. As 
that cooks, knead crushed bloomstone grains with a little water 
until a coarse dough forms, heat on a flat stone near the ribs. 
Within moments, you will have a hearty meal that invigorates, 
strengthens your limbs and lends a certain fiery confidence.
Benefits Gain Advantage on Athletic (Strength) and Intimidation 
(Charisma) rolls and gain +2d4 Temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.
Stubborn Stew
Mash the mustermold mushrooms with a healthy amount of 
water into a thick creamy sauce, add sliced chunks of sacrissian 
marbled tail meat. When thoroughly cooked, add crushed 
thornet garnet for a tasty sweetness to center the mind.
Benefits Gain Resistance to Psychic damage, Saving Throw 
Advantage against the Charmed condition and +1d10 Temporary 
Hit Points for 1 hour.
Many Moon Salad
Cut the long streamweed leaves and gently wash in cold water. 
Slice the glowing eloom into quarters and mix into the leaves. 
Crush the unsundew bulbs into a creamy glowing sauce and 
drizzle them over the salad and serve, preferably at night to enjoy 
the iridescent ingredients.
Benefits Gain Advantage on Saving Throws against the Frightened 
condition, +5 Movement Speed and +1d6 Temporary Hit Points 
for 1 hour.
Stalkers Steaks
Cut the skith tail segment and grinfin meat into thin slices and 
sear over a hot pan. When cooked, stack the slices with a drizzle 
of sanguinite sap between the slices and sprinkle heavily with 
coral salt. The salty bites quicken the blood and quiet the nerves.
Benefits Gain +1 Dexterity and +1 to your Initiative rolls 
for 2 hours, Advantage on Stealth (Dexterity) checks, and 
+2d4 Temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.
Long Stride Drumstick
Grill the large hectatrex drumstick over a low fire until it becomes 
a rich brown, then cut the ferastack column into thick slices and 
place them on the grill when the meat is ready to be flipped. After 
waiting a few moments to allow the ferastack slices to crisp, pull 
both from the grill and enjoy an invigorating meal that fills one 
with a near exhaustible stamina.
Benefits Gain +10 Movement Speed and do not count the first 
level of Exhaustion suffered for 1 hour.
Saltspray Hair
Boil a pot of water and add brinebloom stalks to soak and soften. 
While it boils, slice cerropohol and miremere meat into small 
cubes and sear in a hot pan. Once the stalks are soft, stir in the 
meat cubes and let it continue boiling for a few moments before 
straining the water and serving the warm fortifying meal.
Benefits Gain +1 Constitution, +1d4 and +1d6 Temporary Hit 
Points for 1 hour.
Rose Petal Shake
Chop the solmundis tongue into tiny pieces and crush them into 
a fine paste, then blend the meat into a pot of pebbleback auhk 
milk and boil for 10 minutes. When thoroughly steaming, add 
in sliced scorpithine pygidium petals and shake. Once the warm 
pink milkshake is drunk, the drinker finds themselves able to 
sway others with an ease like never before.
Benefits Gain Advantage on Persuasion (Charisma), Insight 
(Wisdom) and Animal Handling (Wisdom) checks for 1 hour. 
Nights Eye Pie
Sculpt the waxcap mushroom into a bowl-like shape and bake for 
an hour, when firm, fill it with slices of taddil fish, sea bead fruit 
slices and water. Continue to bake for another hour and serve for 
a wholesome meal that alights the night sky with a clarity and 
hastens the limbs with vigor.
Benefits Gain Darkvision for up to 30 ft., +5 Movement Speed and 
Advantage on Nature (Wisdom) checks for Tracking for 1 hour.

WAYWARD
Recipe Examples
Whether in the safety of a cozy camp, or from under a leafy shelter, keeping a weak flame from guttering out in the rain, a well cooked 
meal can warm the spirit and help prepare for the trials of the day. Travelers who venture out into the wilds can safely live off the land 
when they know what to look for and how to cook it. Below can be found eight example recipes, tried and true meals to bolster any 
Traveler. But this list is meager compared to what is possible out there with so many potential ingredients, and it is recommended 
that a Traveler try their own hand at preparing meals with the flora and fauna that inhabit Sol'Kesh, noting down their findings and 
exploring what the island has to offer. 
Foraging
As the sun sets and twilit stars appear across 
the darkening sky, thick coral plates split 
open to reveal a glowing bloom of tentacles 
to the cool night air, inviting seaborne moths 
to both feast and carry their polyps down the 
coast to propagate the coral further
This river fish swims awkwardly 
by twisting its head back and forth 
to deter predators with its wickedly 
sharp facial spikes. While primarily 
used for defense, the protruding spines 
easily get caught on fresh water grass, 
allowing the fish to nibble on the move
